import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    t = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ""
    
    n = len(s)
    m = len(t)
    
    distinct_count = 0
    
    seen = set()
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        prefix_s = s[:i]
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            candidate = prefix_s + t[:j]
            if candidate not in seen:
                seen.add(candidate)
                distinct_count += 1
    
    print(distinct_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
